categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land, including detailed property descriptions, ownership information, encumbrances, and legal status. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazette category as it focuses on land registration, title settlement, and property ownership matters without any government personnel changes or structural administrative modifications.
